goal: Mirror the .agents/ maintainer-tooling slice of pmcro-skills_archive into this repo, scoped to exactly what the human directed after two rounds of trimming.

steps.action: Verified pmcro-skills_archive is real via git ls-remote from the users own machine (cloud sandbox WebFetch was unreliable/self-contradictory and was not trusted). Shallow-cloned main to a scratch dir and read the real .agents/ tree instead of trusting a pasted transcript from an unrelated AI tool.

Ported skills/create-skill, create-skill-test, improve-skill-quality (+ its references/writing-for-baseline-delta.md) and README.md. Rewrote create-skill's Plugin targets list to this repos actual 6 plugins (archive had drifted to pmcro-system/pmcro-strategy/pmcro-actuator). Dropped the PMCRO Output Law section and maf:native_skill frontmatter from every ported SKILL.md -- neither .pmcro/runtime/output-contract.md nor a MAF runtime exists in this repo.

Per explicit human direction (matching the trim made in the archive sessions own redesign): removed plugins/marketplace.json mirror, agents/skill-quality-reviewer.agent.md, commands/ (agents-sync-check.md + export-source.md), memory/, and skills/export-source/ in full -- including scripts/export_source.py, which was actually run against this repo first (produced a valid 266KB handoff, correct commit hash, correct tree) before being cut regardless of working correctly.

Grepped the kept .agents/ tree for dangling references to every removed thing (export-source, agents-sync-check, skill-quality-reviewer, MAF, native_skill, Output Law): every hit was inside READMEs own explanatory Source and adaptation section, none inside a live SKILL.md. Confirmed final tree matches exactly: README.md + skills/{create-skill,create-skill-test,improve-skill-quality}.

success_criteria: .agents/ exists with exactly README.md + skills/create-skill + skills/create-skill-test + skills/improve-skill-quality (with its references/) -- nothing else
create-skill/SKILL.md Plugin targets names this repos real 6 plugins, not archive-drifted names
No ported file asserts MAF, an output-contract.md, or an eval.yaml as already-existing infrastructure this repo does not have
README.md documents source (archive + commit) and every adaptation/removal, so nothing here reads as native original content
out_of_scope: Mirroring .pmcro/ (laws, policies, capabilities, providers, 38 sealed trails) from the archive -- a separate, much larger decision not made this cycle
Mirroring the archives unrelated marketplace plugins (github, cloudflare, copilotkit, machine-learning, prompt-engineering)
Adopting MAF, eval.yaml enforcement, or an output-contract.md in this repo -- explicitly deferred, not decided against
